change: Per-action quarantine feedback includes bound tool identity, pre/post phase, classifier reason and causal explanation; session stays available.

packaged_live_tests.model: local deterministic OpenAI-compatible fixture; no external LLM
packaged_live_tests.installation: Standalone packaged bundle without plugin node_modules
verification: Quarantine/tool/phase/stub reason reach the actual next model request.
The rejected pre call does not execute; blocked post content is withheld.
Each case continues with another approved tool and a new user turn in the same session/server/plugin.
packaged_live_tests.scope: Targeted quarantine regression suite; previous full live matrix was not repeated for this text/feedback change.

verified: Classifier reason survives both pre rejection and post replacement.
Stub quarantine is explicitly marked as a test; technical failures do not assert attack detection.
Tool identity is captured before asynchronous waits; tool/reason labels are bounded escaped JSON data.
Post replacement retains complete original result/error scrubbing; no session latch or abort was added.

limits: Always-deny stub does not detect threats. Classifier unavailability intentionally fails open.
Live tests use builtin shell and direct local MCP; special slash/subtask and experimental background execution are outside this live suite.
V1 ordinary tool exceptions can bypass post. Previously emitted metadata, external side effects and truncation files cannot be retracted.

Special slash/subtask pre refusal may end the current turn; it installs no session latch. This path may copy attachments before post. Background completion messages bypass the original post checkpoint.
No OS sandbox, exact final provider payload or complete ordinary MCP definition catalog is provided.
Known startup failure remains: if initialization fails before hooks are returned, OpenCode may continue without sensor enforcement.
Observed journals and cancelled invocation records are not automatically restored or rotated; a cancelled invocation is retained until a late post or session deletion.
Feedback is returned through tool error/result and asks the model to explain it. No separate assistant message is inserted; exact final chat wording is not guaranteed.
Tool names and classifier reasons are limited to 200 and 1000 source characters, with an explicit truncation marker.

known_open_findings.summary: Plugin initialization failure may leave OpenCode without sensor hooks; unchanged and outside the requested per-action cancellation fix.
